{{Quote|I am a protocol droid! No one would be cruel enough to leave their loyal servant. Anyway, he couldn't do without me. I am fluent in over 1.5 million forms of communication and am excellent in facilitating diplomacy.|C-3TC|<ref name="SWG:SC" />}}
'''C-3TC''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was under the ownership of [[Valance Serth]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Yes, well...he's also the one responsible for getting me into trouble in the first place and I'm tired of it. If you head back to Moenia anytime soon, would you talk to him and have him run this program for me? It will wipe his memory and I won't have to worry about Black Sun goons anymore.|Valance Serth, about C-3TC|<ref name="SWG:BSP">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Black Sun Plots|Talus}}</ref>}}
C-3TC was a protocol droid who belonged at the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to [[Valance Serth]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] native to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The droid could speak over 1.5 million forms of communication and described himself as excellent in facilitating diplomacy. However, the C-3TC was very talkative, including about topics that his master would prefer to conceal.<ref name="SWG:SC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Valance Serth discovered that the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate was intending to take the opportunity of a deadly outbreak of [[Ourim Flu]] to make money. Black Sun planned to taint a major shipment of medicinal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to addict the sick people to their chemicals. However, Black Sun quickly found out that Serth had unveiled its scheme.<ref name="SWG:BSP" /> A short time later, Valance Serth had to travel from Corellia to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] where C-3TC was waiting for him.<ref name="SWG:SC" /> Black Sun was unable to find Serth on Corellia but the criminals tracked C-3TC to the Nabooian city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]]. They interrogated the droid who was eager to disclose everything they wanted to known about his master, including his planned trip from Corellia to Naboo. Black Sun promptly set up an ambush and attacked Valance Serth's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian space]]. Serth was hurt while crash-landing in the wilderness of the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] but he survived. Black Sun henchmen immediately pursued him on the planet.<ref name="SWG:BSP" />

Meanwhile, on Naboo, C-3TC was worried because his master never arrived in Moenia. He eventually requested the help of a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who accepted to help him to find Serth. The spacers questioned [[Selan Ellison]] in the [[Moenia Starport]], Naboo, and then [[Amarent Loren]] of the [[Corellian Port Authority]] in the [[Tyrena Starport]], Corellia. They finally discovered that Valance Serth had crashed on Talus and decided to search for him. Fortunately for Serth, the spacers found him at the very same time than Black Sun henchmen and were able to eliminate the criminals.<ref name="SWG:SC" /> Valance Serth was grateful for the rescue but he was worry because there was no much time left to stop the Black Sun. Once again, the spacers accepted to help. They attacked a Black Sun camp in [[Shadowbrak Ridge]] where the tainted spice was processed but it was too late to prevent the vessel transporting the spice to take off. The spacers soon launched into Corellian space and intercepted the Black Sun convoy. They attacked the criminal [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and succeeded in destroying the transport and the spice. The victorious spacers later came back to Serth who asked a last favor: wipe C-3TC's memory to prevent the droid to provide any information that could harm his master. The spacers later returned to Moenia where the droid was still waiting for his master and commanded him to run a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] program. C-3TC obeyed and eventually forgot every memories of Valance Serth.<ref name="SWG:BSP" />

==Behind the scenes==
C-3TC was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> C-3TC was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

C-3TC would at one point appear silver in color, but was later updated to permanently appear red. This red appearance was further corroborated by the "Quest Highlights" Friday Feature.
